from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,json,os,sys
R=Path.cwd();D=R/'.tools/runtime5-quiet-integration/explicit-campaign-swr1h9d0';O=R/'.tools/review7-quiet-request-audit';O.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def dec(s):return base64.b64decode(s,validate=True)
sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'tests/semantics'));import request_environment as q
complete=read(D/'complete.json');assert complete['pass'] and complete['native_calls']==263 and complete['worker_calls']==526
m=read(R/'.tools/runtime5-quiet-integration/final-inputs.json')
for n,h in m['files'].items():assert sha(R/n)==h,n
reportpath=R/'coverage/semantics/request-environment-source.json';report=read(reportpath)
assert report['result']=='pass' and report['selected_cases']==report['catalogue_cases']==263 and report['selection']==''
assert report['fingerprint']==complete['fingerprint']==m['fingerprint']
assert not (D/'failure.txt').exists() and not list(D.glob('*exception.json'))
assert len(list(D.glob('native-*-input.json')))==len(list(D.glob('native-*-result.json')))==263
assert len(list(D.glob('worker-*-input.json')))==len(list(D.glob('worker-*-result.json')))==526
assert read(D/'inputs.json')==m['files'] and sha(D/'author-script.py')==m['wrappers']['.tools/run-request-quiet-explicit.py']
records=[]
for i,(row,case) in enumerate(zip(report['records'],q.CASES,strict=True)):
 assert row['id']==case['id'] and dec(row['source_base64'])==case['source'] and row['pass']
 ni=read(D/f'native-{i:04}-input.json');nr=read(D/f'native-{i:04}-result.json')
 pi=read(D/f'worker-{2*i:04}-input.json');pr=read(D/f'worker-{2*i:04}-result.json')['response']
 ei=read(D/f'worker-{2*i+1:04}-input.json');er=read(D/f'worker-{2*i+1:04}-result.json')['response']
 assert ni['source_base64']==row['source_base64'] and ni['source_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(case['source']).hexdigest()
 assert ni['payload_sha256']==row['payload_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(dec(ni['payload_base64'])).hexdigest()
 req=row['request'];entries=[dec(k)+b'='+dec(v) for k,v in req['env']]
 assert dec(ni['payload_base64'])==q.packet(int(req['seconds']),req['microseconds'],entries)
 assert entries==case.get('environment',[b'LC_ALL=C',b'TZ=UTC',b'FIRST=one'])
 assert [int(req['seconds']),req['microseconds']]==case.get('clock',[1700000000,125000])
 assert [dec(a) for a in req['argv'][1:]]==case.get('argv',[b'alpha',b'beta'])
 assert dec(req['file'])==dec(req['argv'][0])==os.fsencode(row['invocation_spelling'])
 assert dec(req['cwd'])==dec(ni['cwd_base64'])==os.fsencode(row['native_cwd'])
 config=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in case.get('extra_ini',[]))
 assert dec(req['variables'])==config.get('variables_order','EGPCS').encode() and req['jit']==(config.get('auto_globals_jit','1')!='0')
 expected=[os.fsencode(q.t.PHP),b'-n',*[os.fsencode(x) for x in q.t.FLAGS],b'-d',b'variables_order=EGPCS',*[os.fsencode(arg) for x in case.get('extra_ini',[]) for arg in ['-d',x]],*[dec(a) for a in req['argv']]]
 assert [dec(x) for x in ni['command_base64']]==expected
 assert ni['loader_environment']=={'LD_PRELOAD':str(R/'.tools/request-clock.so')} and ni['timeout']==10
 assert {k:nr[k] for k in ['stdout','stderr','exit_status']}=={k:row['oracle'][k] for k in ['stdout','stderr','exit_status']}
 assert Path(ni['source_context']).resolve()==Path(row['context']).resolve() and Path(row['context']).read_bytes()==case['source']
 assert [dec(x) for x in pi['command_base64']]==[os.fsencode(q.t.PHP),b'-n',*[os.fsencode(x) for x in q.t.FLAGS],b'-d',os.fsencode('extension='+str(R/'.tools/php-file.so')),os.fsencode(R/'frontend/worker.php')]
 assert pi['request']=={'op':'parse','source':row['source_base64']} and pr['accepted'] and pr['ok']
 assert ei['request']=={'op':'execute','ast':pr['ast'],'steps':10000,'filename':q.b64(os.fsencode(row['context'])),'request':req}
 assert er['ok'] and hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(er['state'],sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()==row['state_sha256']
 observed=q.cli.observe(er['state'],row['context']);assert observed==row['actual']
 assert observed['status'] in ['normal','php_error','static_rejection'] and all(observed[k]==row['oracle'][k] for k in ['stdout','stderr','exit_status'])
 assert [dec(x) for x in ei['command_base64']]==[os.fsencode(R/'_build/default/adapter/main.exe'),os.fsencode(R)]
 records.append({'id':row['id'],'source_sha256':ni['source_sha256'],'native_index':i,'parse_index':2*i,'execute_index':2*i+1,'state_sha256':row['state_sha256'],'comparison':'pass'})
for n,h in m['files'].items():assert sha(R/n)==h,n
out={'result':'pass','scope':'Independent exact raw audit of fresh canonical263 explicit-request source comparisons. Native primitive payloads/argv/cwd/loader, original sources, frontend AST, typed request and full state/CLI outcomes checked for every case. Ordinary uninstrumented campaign and full core closure remain separate.','fingerprint':m['fingerprint'],'manifest_sha256':sha(R/'.tools/runtime5-quiet-integration/final-inputs.json'),'report_sha256':sha(reportpath),'raw_root':str(D.relative_to(R)),'native_calls':263,'worker_calls':526,'records':records,'raw_index':{str(p.relative_to(D)):sha(p) for p in sorted(D.glob('*')) if p.is_file()}}
(O/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print('PASS263 exact native/parse/execute source rows;526 complete Worker responses; all explicit primitive profiles exact')
